Brands of Imperium is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from White Gold Tower and the Daedric Embers Trophy Vault. It is a Heavy Armor set, and items are in the Xivkyn Style.

The Bow of Penumbra is a bow found in . It can inflict poison damage in addition to its regular damage.

Brawler's Leather Bracers are a piece of light armor available with the Fearsome Fists creation in .

The Bruma chapterhouse has no definite school of magic, instead having various. The Guild also sells various schools of spells.

Brusef Amelion's Greaves are a type of greaves found in and part of Brusef Amelion's Armor.
Brusef Amelion's Helmet is a type of armor found in and a part of Brusef Amelion's Armor.
The Broken Shield is a shield belonging to Modryn Oreyn of the Chorrol Fighters Guild.

Brusef Amelion's Shield is a light armor shield found in the Amelion Tomb. The Hero can keep this shield as it is only the sword and the Brusef Amelion's Cuirass that they must give away instead of paying the money to complete the "Amelion's Debt" quest.

The Bruma Shield is a special Light Iron Shield worn by members of the Bruma Town Guard. It differs in shape and appearance from the other Town Guards' shields, since it bears the symbol of Bruma and has an oval shape. This shield lacks any special effects.
Brooms are miscellaneous items found throughout Skyrim. The only use they have are in staff creation at the Atronach Forge.
Brunwulf Free-Winter is a Nord former soldier who lives on the east side of Windhelm and wears scaled horn armor. He is also Ulfric's replacement as Jarl if the Imperial Legion occupies Eastmarch.

Broken Iron Sword Handle is an item in that is found right next to a Broken Iron Sword Handle, other part from a set.

Broken Iron War Axe Head is an item in that is found near to a broken iron war axe handle, other part from a set.

Broken Steel Battle Axe Head is an item in that is found near to a Broken Steel Battle Axe Handle, other part from a set.

Broken Steel Greatsword Handle is a miscellaneous item in . It is a set of two, coupled with the Broken Steel Greatsword Blade.
Broken Steel Sword Blade is an item in . It is a set of two, coupled with the Broken Steel Sword Handle.

Brynjolfr is a Nord blacksmith living in a hut just north of Thirsk. He can craft Snow Bear Armor if the Nerevarine provides him with snow bear pelts, or Snow Wolf Armor if provided with snow wolf pelts. He provides a non-negotiable price list for this service upon request. He is also a merchant and buys/sells various armor and weapons. Brynjolfr has information on a missing missionary that may prove useful.
Bthuangth's Harvester is a unique Two-Handed Dwarven weapon. It is enchanted to cast soultrap on strike, simplifying the capture of an opponent's soul in a gem for use in enchanting.

Brunwyn Laffoon is a Breton waiting by the docks of Daggerfall, Glenumbra, for her ship to come in. Apparently she has sent a message to Headman Bhosek about her concerns about Captain Helane and her band of Sea Drakes.

Broken Arch is the crafting location that appears in the region of Reaper's March in . This location allows the Vestige to craft unique Armor Sets, if they have researched a sufficient number of Traits. The set Hunding's Rage can be crafted from here.
Broadhead Shield is a shield in . It is given to the Vestige as a reward for completing the quest "Cast Adrift." It is part of the Armor of the Trainee set.
Brittlewind is a Destruction spell in that inflicts elemental frost damage while simultaneously damaging an armor and weapons upon multiple victims.
Bring It! is a quest available in in which Harrald asks the Dragonborn to pick up his sword from Balimund in Riften.
Bright-Throat's Boast is an overland set in . It can be obtained from activities throughout Murkmire. It is a Light Armor set, and items are in the Elder Argonian Style.
Bugdurash gra-Gashel is an Orsimer who resides in Maar Gan. She trains in Block and in Medium Armor. She is involved in one Fighter's guild quest.
Burning Light is a Templar passive skill in the Aedric Spear skill line in .
Caalore is an Altmer tailor and one of the two people working at Artaeum Armor and Vestments in Haven.
By The Sword is a weaponsmith stall that appears in the city of Davon's Watch.
Buffer of the Swift is an item set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
Burning Spellweave is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in City of Ash.

Cadwell's Lost Robe is a piece of light armor in obtained from the Sealed Urn after completing the quest "Soul Shriven in Coldharbour." It was previously owned by Cadwell, a soul shriven denizen of Coldharbour, before losing it.
Business Ledger Copy is a book in that is a part of the Bow of Shadows Creation Club content.
The Camonna Tong Thugs are sitting at Walker Camp at the foot of the mountains near Lord Rugdumph's Estate. Their "faction" is non-joinable, even for a Dunmer.
Canopy Helmet is an enchanted elven helmet found in that has a resist magic effect.

Captain Helane is the leader of the Sea Drakes in Saintsport on the island of Stros M'Kai. She owns the ship Bloody Witch, anchored in the docks of Saintsport. She is the target of Bhosek the Bloody, as seen in the note Bhosek's Punishments. In the quest "Like Moths to a Candle," she gets poisoned by Crafty Lerisa. The Vestige can give her the antidote, kill her, or let her die.
Camille Phien is a Breton merchant who resides in the city of Daggerfall. She can be found in the market, selling light armor.
Captain Currod is a Redguard residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven, in . He is the captain of the ship The Tava's Bounty, currently in the docks. Kaliq is his first mate.

Captain Jimila is a Khajiit captain of The Prowler, a beached ship found on the west side of Khenarthi's Roost, in the Shattered Shoals. Upon approach, she will request that the Vestige finds and saves two of her missing crew, who have been taken to be killed in a Maormer ritual. Later, the repaired Prowler ship will take the Vestige to Auridon, after having saved Khenarthi's Roost from another Maormer plot.
Captain Bones' Ship is a world boss location that appears in the region of Shadowfen in .
Captain Jemalsorr is a Nord sailor found on his ship, The Rusty Argonian Blade, which is currently docked at the dockyards of Davon's Watch.

Captain Henrisa is a Breton ship captain in High King Emeric's naval fleet. She was tasked with escorting Lady Sovelle, an ambassador from Daggerfall, to Orsinium. She secretly holds a great hatred for Orcs and she is later responsible for holding the ambassador captive due for Sovelle's appreciation of them. Her ship is the Materre's Fortune.

Calderas is an item found in . This spear was once used by Dranoth, patriarch of House Hleran, to deal the killing blow to the legendary enemy of the Ashlanders, Skar the Emperor Crab. It is too old and worn to be used as a weapon but carries great symbolic power to the Ashlanders.
Captain Ahnu is a Redguard captain of the Bjoulsae Queen, a ship in Evermore. She helped to deliver the supplies from the Seventh Legion on the orders of Duke Renchant.
Caluurion's Legacy is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Fang Lair. It is a Light Armor set, and items are in the Fang Lair Style.
Captain Ithala is a Maormer Dreadsail in and is the boss of Shipwreck Shoals. She uses a Dreadsails Style bow and heavy armor.
Captain Wayfinder is a Nord ship captain in who can be found on his ship, the Sea Squall, in Dawnstar, conversing with his crew.
Captain Roberto Jodoin is a Breton shipmaster found in the Isinfier Plains. He was hired by Louis Beauchamp as a Patchwork Airship captain.

Captain Modyn Veleth is a Dunmer found in Raven Rock. He is the captain of the Redoran Guard stationed at Raven Rock. He wears Bonemold Armor like his men, but wears the Bonemold Guard Armor instead of the Bonemold Pauldron Armor, and is often seen equipped with an Elven Battleaxe. If the Dragonborn saves him during the quest "March of the Dead," he will thank them by saying, "Thanks... I wasn't sure I'd make it off this farm alive. I wish I could have said the same for my man here."
Carmine Dart is a poisoned throwing weapon that damages an adversary's Fatigue in addition to Health. This weapon is used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple Sewers.
Captain Tremouille is a Breton in who resides in the city of Vulkhel Guard, initially on the ship The Interim Suitor.
Captain Rosalind's Blade is a one-handed sword received as a reward for completing the quest "The Ghosts of Westtry."
Captive Crewmembers is a quest available in . The slavers have captured the crew of a ship that crashed on the rocks. Captain Albert Marck has asked the Vestige to free them.
Captain Sa'dir is a Khajiit and the leader of the Renrijra Maor party operating in Deshaan. He is found aboard his ship, The Crafty Monkey, docked east of the Silent Mire.
Carimalda is an Altmer fighter and member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Marbruk.

Captain Svadstar is a Dunmer residing on Firemoth Island, Vvardenfell, in . She only appears on the Slaver ship, and cannot be directly interacted with, as Naryu Virian kills them as soon as they appear during the quest "Broken Bonds."

---- Captain Tobias’ Sword-Meeting with Cyrus the Restless, also called Cyrus Versus Captain Tobias (abbreviated cvc), is an unreleased project produced by former writer/art director Michael Kirkbride and lead designer Kurt Kuhlmann. It is an audio story featuring the original voice of Cyrus, Michael Mack, and the voiceover recordings were completed on Dec 14th, 2013. It was announced on November 25, 2013 in celebration of the 15th anniversary of TEA: Redguard. The link to the project can be [https://www.c0da.es/cvc found at c0da.es]. Regarding the release, Kirkbride said in 2015 that he needed "to get the story to feel right". In 2021, he further explained that "The VO was recorded long ago. Some illustrations exist. Kurt’s bit of the writing exists, but mine is scattershot. I love all of the existing elements, but I’m also well known for abandoning projects for large amounts of time. Short and unexciting answer: maybe one day. [...] it’s a story that needs to be told in a specific way, as the prose and voiceover intertwine. Also, I told Michael Mack in what format his voice would be used, and I must hold to that. But... who knows, maybe I could release a snippet of it sometime in the near future, because frankly hearing a bit of the story in his voice is fucking awesome." ----
Chainmail Armor is made of interlocking links of metal, forming a light and flexible, yet sturdy armor that provides better protection than fur and leather armor but less than mithril.

Ceremonial Armor is the armor equivalent of replica weapons; this type of armor is completely useless. Most ceremonial armor pieces are found in royalty display cases or guild halls, usually with Very Hard locks. These items look exactly like the real item and are simply there for cosmetic and decorative purpose. Enchanting ceremonial armor with shield would provide a high level, cost effective, easy access armor.

The Caverns is a location in . North of Port Hunding can be found a large pit revealing a derelict ship. There is no safe way for Cyrus to explore it, effectively making it a death trap.

Here, as in most native style, a scarf protects the neck and mouth from blowing sand and ash while campaigning.

Cleftside Espaulders is a piece of medium armor in . This is a reward from the quest "A Dangerous Dream."
Clawrunner Skin is a consumable item in ; its short name is ClawSkin. Clawrunner Skin adds 2 to Defense value, 2 to Armor value, 10 to Strength for 300 seconds.
Cingulnya is a Maormer found aboard The Dreamsnake, a ship docked in Abah's Landing.

Codus runs a tight ship and makes sure to apply the rules of the arena, refusing to fix any matches, as drawing in crowds are his main priority. He is also the brother of the Pirate Queen, Governor Fortunata ap Dugal, but does not speak to his sister and prefers to stay out of her affairs.

A Crafted Item Set can be made by blacksmithing, clothing and woodworking and gives special bonuses to the weapon or armor crafted. Crafting these requires that the player has researched a few different traits already, but doesn't affect which bonuses are given to the set. More researched traits are required at the stations found in higher level zones. To gain the bonuses, the player must wear a given number of set pieces (3 or 5 pieces). These sets can only be crafted in certain locations scattered around the world and different bonuses are found at different crafting stations. All sets found in one faction's territory can also be found in the other two faction's regions of equal level difficulty. Since the player is able to craft 7 armor pieces in total, along with weapons (including sword and shield), it is possible to wear 9 items with set bonuses. This means the player can wear either a 5 set-bonus plus a 3 set-bonus or three 3 set-bonuses to maximize set-bonuses. Equipment with bonuses like these can also be found in dungeons and bought with Alliance Points. These are different set bonuses however.

Cowardice, previously Lower Spell Power, is an effect encountered in that reduces Weapon and Spell Damage for a short period of time. It can be created using alchemical reagents. Its opposing effect is Increase Spell Power.

The Craft Bag is a special part of the player's inventory, available as part of an ESO Plus subscription. It does not take up any space and can store an unlimited amount of all crafting and style materials.

Crafting Materials are Crafting items in . Crafting Materials determine the level of armor, weapons, shields and jewelry. .]] Crafting Styles in allow the player to craft sets of armor and weapons in particular styles. These styles play an important role in character customization and allows players to modify their character's appearance based on their preferences. Aside from the racial styles, which are automatically learned dependent on the player character's race, all crafting styles require obtaining certain crafting motifs, which in turn can be obtained by finding them as random loot, receiving them as rewards for completing world events or repeatable quests, trading with merchants or trading with other players. These Motifs allow the player to craft weapons and armor corresponding with its contents. Some crafting styles are only available to players that purchased special editions of the game or through purchase of an expansion. Certain materials are required to create different styles. These materials can be found as random loot, obtained through deconstructing an item of a particular style or they can be purchased from merchants. Alternatively, if one lacks the required materials to craft certain styles, they can purchase Crown Mimic Stones from the Crown Store to serve as a substitute. Crafting quests are quests in where the Vestige is required to craft specified items using the alchemy, blacksmithing, clothing, enchanting, jewelry crafting, provisioning, or woodworking skill. Each day, repeatable crafting quests are available at writ boards in major cities that can be completed for experience, survey reports, inspiration, and items. To do these quests, introductory certification quests must first be completed: a general certification first, followed by a specific certification for each crafting skill. Completing daily writs can provide master writs that can be completed for writ vouchers () used to buy unique items. All jewelry crafting quests require .
